Name: Pinzon Fleur Jacquard Egyptian Cotton Sateen 20-By-20-Inch Pillow Cover, French Blue/Chocolate
Colors: French Blue/Chocolate

Decorative pillow cover with a sophisticated, wide-Jacquard stripe pattern; made in Portugal Made of 100-percent Egyptian cotton in a Sateen weave; 1-ply yarns Self reverse, with blue piping all around Machine washable in cold water; coordinates with Pinzon Fleur Jacquard collection Measures 20 by 20 inches
